about_the_game:
The Last Tape: Before The Mine

"It was just a tape. Just memories… until it wasn’t."

The Last Tape: Before The Mine is the first official chapter in a dark, psychological horror story told in first person—where memories are not just echoes of the past, but open doors to terror.

Following the events of the prologue (available for FREE on Steam), Gabriel plays the first recovered tape found in the ruins of Lurmont's old facilities—a company that in the 1990s conducted horrific experiments beneath the cover of a peaceful mining operation in Alhambra, Spain. As he desperately searches for answers, a threat known as B-96 lurks nearby… waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

🕯️ YOU ARE NOT ALONE

Just because you’re watching a recording doesn’t mean you’re safe. B-96 roams in real time, stalking you as you watch the footage. At any moment, you may be forced to stop the tape and act fast to survive.

🏃 FIGHTING IS NOT AN OPTION

You are no warrior. You have no weapons. You’ll need to run, hide, and use the environment to your advantage while uncovering the twisted truth behind the horrors buried in the mountain.

📼 TWO SURVIVORS, ONE CONNECTION

You’ll experience two interwoven narratives:

  • Gabriel, in the present day, vulnerable and hunted by B-96 while trying to decipher the footage.

  • The protagonist of the tape, one of the teens who suffered through Lurmont’s nightmare back in 1995.

Both must survive. One in the past. One in the present. Your constant attention is key to keeping them alive.

🏚️ LURMONT COMPANY – 1995

Over four decades ago, Lurmont discovered strange minerals in the Alhambra forest mines. With no government oversight and a “harmless” public image, the company operated in secrecy—until something went terribly wrong. Years later, a group of teens exploring the area vanished under mysterious circumstances.
Only one tape remained.

📖 CHAPTER ONE

This game marks the first chapter of the main story in The Last Tape. For a complete narrative experience, it is highly recommended to play the FREE Prologue available on Steam before starting this chapter.

Are you ready to press Play?
This tape doesn’t just show horror. It makes you live it.

  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X | Intel Core i7-9700K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 570 | NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 11 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5600 | Intel Core i7-10700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 7800X | NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 11 GB available space

short_description: In this first chapter of the saga, relive an old tape recorded over 35 years ago, revealing one of Lurmont Corporation’s darkest secrets. Explore the Alhambra mines, uncover the truth behind the events, and survive the constant threat of B-96. What was once recorded now hunts you.
